description: This is a configuration class for the Goteo application, responsible for loading, managing, and accessing the application's configuration settings from YAML files, environment variables, and other sources. It includes methods for setting constants, managing controllers, and integrating plugin modules.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Main configuration management class for the Goteo application, responsible for loading configuration data from YAML files, managing environment variables, setting application constants, and organizing controllers and modules.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads configuration files, merges settings, initializes dependencies, and sets up environment variables and constants.

methods.name: loadFromYaml
methods.description: Loads and parses a YAML configuration file using Symfony's YAML loader.

methods.name: autosave
methods.description: Performs automatic saving of roles configuration if enabled.

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Clears cached YAML configuration files.

methods.name: setLoader
methods.description: Registers a Composer ClassLoader for autoloading classes.

methods.name: getLoader
methods.description: Retrieves the current registered ClassLoader.

methods.name: addAutoloadDir
methods.description: Adds a directory to Composer's autoload.

methods.name: addComposerAutoload
methods.description: Includes and adds an external autoload.php file, integrating it into the current autoloader.

methods.name: setDirConfiguration
methods.description: Sets up application directories, routes, plugins, and controllers, and initializes various services.

methods.name: addAdminControllers
methods.description: Registers a predefined set of administrative controllers.

methods.name: addLegacyAdminControllers
methods.description: Registers a set of legacy administrative controllers.

methods.name: setConstants
methods.description: Defines global constants based on configuration values, including database, environment, and OAuth settings.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves configuration values by dot notation, optionally strictly throwing exceptions if not found.

methods.name: replaceEnvVars
methods.description: Replaces placeholders with environment variable values.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a configuration value programmatically.

methods.name: _set
methods.description: Internal helper for setting nested configuration keys.

methods.name: getMail
methods.description: Retrieves the appropriate email configuration.

methods.name: getUrl
methods.description: Constructs and returns a URL, optionally language-specific.

methods.name: getMainUrl
methods.description: Returns the sanitized main URL of the application.

methods.name: getPlugins
methods.description: Returns a list of active plugins based on configuration.

methods.name: isCurrentNode
methods.description: Checks if the current node matches the given node identifier.

methods.name: isMasterNode
methods.description: Checks if the current node is the master node or matches a specific node.
